name: Shinkawa (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Shinkawa town emblem in white: a stylised angular device of diagonal strokes, like a letter h.
history: Flag of the former town of Shinkawa in Aichi Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-07-07. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1964.

features.role: Shinkawa town emblem — a stylised angular device of diagonal strokes, like a letter h
